Method of Attack: Exploitation of Kubernetes API discovery calls to escalate privileges to cluster-admin level
Privilege escalation via 'exec', 'attach', or 'portforward' rights over Kubernetes pods
Exploitation of API extension feature used by 'metrics-server' and 'servicecatalog' allowing unauthenticated admin access
Attack Vector: Discovery API calls accessible to all users (authenticated and unauthenticated)
Normal user privileges with exec, attach, or portforward rights on pods
Unauthenticated access to API extensions in the cluster
